versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Training Specialist skill.

- Helps users get started and succeed with AI training platforms: Scale AI, Remotasks, DataAnnotation, Surge AI, Appen, Prolific, Invisible Technologies, Toloka.
- Provides guidance on judgment-based AI evaluation tasks: response ranking/rating, RLHF evaluation, hallucination and factuality review, text classification, content moderation.
- Features a step-by-step workflow for onboarding, assessment prep, skill development, and earnings optimization.
- Includes platform comparisons and best-practice principles for high-quality human evaluation work.
- Subscription pricing set at $25.
